name: Vulcan CERT-2 Payload
about: Vulcan CERT-2 Payload (2024-179A, ULAL), launched 2024 Oct  4. Its phases from GCAT: HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
